The Witness co-op: other people's work in this mod
====================================================

The co-op mod itself is under the MIT licence in LICENSE.txt. It contains the work of other projects, also under the MIT licence.
Their notices follow, as their licences ask. Thank you to everyone named here.


1. The randomizers (the launcher's Randomizers tab)
---------------------------------------------------

Sigma's Randomizer (Normal and Expert) and the Variety Randomizer are built into the mod from the Witness Random Puzzle Generator,
as maintained for Archipelago by NewSoupVi:
    https://github.com/NewSoupVi/The-Witness-Randomizer-for-Archipelago

It is the work of sigma144 (the puzzle generator, Normal and Expert: https://github.com/sigma144/witness-randomizer), jbzdarkid
(the original Witness randomizer: https://github.com/jbzdarkid/witness-randomizer), Penguin12335 (Variety:
https://github.com/Penguin12335/Variety-Randomiser), NewSoupVi, blastron, Jarno458, hatkirby, ReverM and others.

The mod runs its puzzle generator unchanged apart from how it reaches the game: inside the game instead of from a separate program, and
a few small fixes marked "witness-coop" in the source. The authors made it for everyone to use; they did not make or check this co-op
version, so please report problems with it to the co-op mod.

2. Which panels open what ("parts of the map done" for a new game)
-------------------------------------------------------------------

The order in which the game needs its panels solved comes from the logic of Archipelago's world for The Witness:
    https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago (worlds/witness)
